command.convertChangedFiles: Convert changed lines in all files (git)…
command.convertFolder: Convert px values in this folder/file
command.cycleUnit: Cycle unit at cursor (px → rem → em → vw → token)
command.explainKept: Explain px values that stay px
command.rebase: Rebase rem values (change the root font size)…
config.baseFontSize: Root font size in px (1rem). Used when detection is off or finds nothing.
config.baseFontSizeDetection: Detect the root font size from the project.
config.baseFontSizeDetection.auto: Read the root font size from `html`/`:root` rules (e.g. `font-size: 62.5%` → 10px) or a postcss-pxtorem `rootValue`, unless `baseFontSize` is set explicitly.
config.codeLens: Where "Convert N px values" CodeLens appears.
config.codeLens.file: One summary at the top of the file.
config.codeLens.line: One per line with px values.
config.codeLens.rule: One per rule with px values.
config.completion.enable: Suggest rem (and matching tokens) while typing px values.
config.convertMixinArguments: Convert px passed to mixins (`@include size(16px)`). Breakpoint mixins are never touched.
config.convertOnSave: Convert px values when saving. Alternatively add `"source.pxToRem.convert": "explicit"` to `editor.codeActionsOnSave`.
config.convertVariables: Convert values of Sass/Less/Stylus variables and CSS custom properties.
config.designHeight: Design viewport height in px, for vh, vmin and vmax.
config.designWidth: Design viewport width in px, for vw, vmin, vmax and rpx.
config.diagnostics.rules: Severity per rule, merged over the defaults. Rules: `px-unit`, `font-size-px`, `line-height-px`, `letter-spacing-px`, `media-query-px`, `fixed-height-text`, `text-width-px`, `viewport-font-size`, `fluid-zoom`, `off-scale`, `off-palette`, `rem-function-missing`.
config.diagnostics.scope.changedLines: Only report on lines changed since the last commit (git).
config.excludeFiles: Glob patterns for files to ignore (e.g. `**/*.min.css`, `**/vendor/**`). `node_modules` is always ignored.
config.excludePatterns: Regular expressions; lines that match are left alone. Prefer `/* px-to-rem-disable-next-line */` comments.
config.excludeProperties: Never convert these properties (globs such as `border*` work).
config.fileTypes: File extensions included in workspace conversion and statistics.
config.fluid.breakpoints: Viewport widths shown when explaining `clamp()`, `calc()`, `min()` and `max()`.
config.fluid.checkZoom: Check fluid font sizes against WCAG 1.4.4 (text must reach 200% with browser zoom).
config.fluid.maxViewport: Largest viewport width for fluid `clamp()` values.
config.fluid.minViewport: Smallest viewport width for fluid `clamp()` values.
config.fluid.unit: Unit that makes generated `clamp()` values fluid.
config.fluid.unit.cqi: Scale with the nearest container (container query units).
config.format: Output for converted values. Presets: `auto` (uses your `rem()` function in preprocessor files when the project defines one, otherwise `1rem`), `rem` (`1rem`), `rem-function` (`rem(16)`), `rem-function-px` (`rem(16px)`), `em`, `vw`, `vh`, `vmin`, `vmax`, `rpx`, `pt`. Or a template with `{rem}`, `{px}`, `{em}`, `{vw}`, `{vh}`, `{vmin}`, `{vmax}`, `{rpx}`, `{pt}` and `{fn}` (the function name), e.g. `toRem({px})`.
config.functionName: Name of your px-to-rem function, used by the function formats, reverse conversion and helper generation.
config.hairline: Smart mode keeps values up to this many px as px (hairlines, 1px nudges). 0 turns it off.
config.hover.enable: Show conversions, tokens and explanations on hover.
config.includeProperties: Only convert these properties (globs such as `padding*` work). Empty means all.
config.inlayHints.enable: Show px equivalents after rem, em, vw and `rem()` values.
config.inlayHints.variables: Also show resolved values after `var(--x)`, `$x` and `@x`.
config.interpolateInCalc: Wrap function output in `#{}` inside `calc()`, `clamp()`, `min()` and `max()` (Sass).
config.js.objectStyles: Convert px strings in style objects (`{ fontSize: '16px' }`).
config.js.templateLiterals: Convert CSS in styled-components, emotion, Lit and Linaria templates.
config.js.unitlessNumbers: Also convert numbers React treats as px (`{ fontSize: 16 }` → `{ fontSize: '1rem' }`). Off by default; React Native projects never convert.
config.languages: Language ids the extension works in.
config.maxFileSize: Files larger than this many characters skip live features (diagnostics, hints, CodeLens).
config.maxValue: Largest absolute px value to convert.
config.mediaQueries: What to do with px in `@media` and `@container` queries.
config.mediaQueries.em: Convert breakpoints to em (relative to the browser default, so they follow the user font size).
config.mediaQueries.keep: Leave media and container queries alone.
config.mediaQueries.rem: Convert breakpoints to rem (also relative to the browser default inside media queries).
config.mediaQueryBase: Font size media queries are relative to. Browsers use their default (16px), not your `html` font size.
config.minValue: Smallest absolute px value to convert (e.g. 2 keeps 1px).
config.mode.simple: Convert every px value with the same format.
config.mode.smart: Pick the best unit per property: font sizes and spacing become rem, line-height becomes unitless, letter-spacing becomes em, borders and shadows stay px, media queries become em.
config.paste.mode: Convert CSS when pasting (from Figma, DevTools, …).
config.paste.mode.default: Pasting CSS converts it; plain paste stays available in the paste menu.
config.paste.mode.offer: Pasting CSS keeps it as is and offers "Paste as rem" in the paste menu.
config.precision: Maximum number of decimal places in generated values.
config.respectGitignore: Skip files ignored by `.gitignore` in workspace operations.
config.reverseUnits: What "Convert back to px" rewrites: `rem`, `em`, `vw`, `vh`, `vmin`, `vmax`, `rpx`, `pt` and `function` (`rem(16)`).
config.smartRules: Smart mode rules per property (globs allowed), merged over the defaults. Actions: `convert` (use `format`), `rem`, `em` (relative to the element font size), `unitless` (ratio to the element font size), `keep`.
config.statusBar.enable: Show the root font size and px count in the status bar.
config.tailwind.enable: Convert Tailwind arbitrary values such as `p-[16px]`.
config.tailwind.enable.auto: On when the project depends on Tailwind CSS.
config.tailwind.preferScale: Use the scale class when one matches (`p-[16px]` → `p-4`) instead of `p-[1rem]`.
config.title.smart: PX to REM: Smart mode & filters
config.tokens.autoDetect: Find tokens in the workspace when `tokens.sources` is empty.
config.tokens.colors: Also match literal colours against colour tokens.
config.tokens.colorTolerance: Maximum colour difference (CIEDE2000) for suggesting a nearby colour token. Around 2 is barely visible.
config.tokens.enable: Use design tokens (CSS custom properties, Sass/Less/Stylus variables, token JSON files) for snapping, hovers and quick fixes.
config.tokens.preferTokens: When a px value exactly matches a token, convert it to the token (e.g. `var(--space-4)`) instead of rem.
config.tokens.reference: How tokens from JSON files are referenced in CSS. `{name}` is the token path joined with `-`.
config.tokens.sources: Files or globs that define tokens (`.css`, `.scss`, `.less`, `.styl`, DTCG/Tokens Studio/Style Dictionary `.json`). Empty means auto-detect.
config.workspace.maxFiles: Maximum number of files scanned for workspace statistics and conversion.
config.workspace.saveAfterConvert: Save files after a workspace conversion is applied.
description: Convert px to rem, em, vw or your rem() function — per property, in CSS, SCSS, Less, Stylus, Vue, Svelte, Astro, styled-components and Tailwind. Plus fluid clamp(), design-token snapping and accessibility checks.
displayName: PX to REM Toolkit – smart units, fluid type & design tokens
